'''Inondrar''' was an executive officer on board the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] during the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] who was ordered by [[Darth Caedus]] to disable the ''Anakin Solo's'' comms to keep [[Cha Niathal]] from persuading any on board to join her. He would later take the place [[Kral Nevil]] had after abandoning ship in favor of Niathal.
